items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Yeah I used to play with him

ctx.x: Well I don't know but Blind Freddy was good Must have just had a gift I guess the Lord just give him that gift to make a living Yeah and he had one too
Sounds like a good band, did you ever work with him? Yeah I used to play with him
But I played with Wesley Dime in the band See he got killed in Baton-Lewis Yeah He was a little bit of foul but he could play nice corners
